mergedFrom.note: The hevc-4k-hdr10-90m.mkv rows come from a second run of the same protocol, build and origin on the same day and machine. A tvOS Simulator had been left running in the background for the first half of the main run, which raised idle package power to 188 to 214 mW (19 to 26 mW once it was shut down). Both hevc-4k-hdr10-90m.mkv baselines failed validation under it, so that fixture was measured again. The hevc-4k-hdr10.mkv baselines were taken under it too and passed; the GPU idle baseline stayed under 0.05 mW throughout, and CPU load, RSS and footprint are not baseline-subtracted, so none of the published columns moved with it.
